text.p: Malaysian shipping firm Nepline Bhd said on Tuesday it has proposed a four-for-five rights issue of 15.92 million shares at 7.60 ringgit a share.
In a statement, Nepline said it also proposed an employees' share option scheme of not more than 10 percent of the company's issued share capital.
Proceeds from the rights issue will be used to repay borrowings, acquire vessels and for working capital, it said.

Nepline said based on its enlarged share capital after the proposed rights issue of 35.82 million shares, the maximum number of shares available for the share option scheme will be 3.58 million shares.
The scheme will be in force for a period of five years from the date of its approval by shareholders and regulatory authorities, it said.
Nepline stsock closed at 10.10 ringgit on Tuesday.
